Igitur Israël pater eorum dixit ad eos:
Therefore, their father Israel said to them:
“If it is necessary to do so,
sumite de optimis terræ fructibus in vasis vestris,
Take, in your vessels, from the best fruits of the land,

et illam, quam invenistis in sacculis,

ego autem quasi orbatus absque liberis ero.
